newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Budget Committee head wants to freeze funds for DG 10.
newsitem.headline: Budget Committee head wants to freeze funds for DG 10.

text.p: The chairman of the European Parliament's Budget Committee, Detlev Samland, wants the parliament to freeze one half of the 1997 budget of DG 10, the directorate general responsible for information policy.
Samland told reporters this week he considered the directorate inefficient and it should be restructured as an information agency.
The parliament will give the EU 1997 budget a first reading at its plenary session in Strasbourg in two weeks time.
The frozen money would amount to more than 20 million Ecus, Samland said.
EU officials said Oreja was informed of the budget committee's discontent at a closed-door meeting two weeks ago.

Colette Flesch, director general of DG 10, has been given the task of finding a way to meet the committee's concerns before she leaves her post to head the Commission's translation service at the end of the year.
